assert candidate_tree_sha256(repair[\"candidate_tree_oid\"]) == repair[\"candidate_tree_sha256\"]
assert subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"rev-parse\", f'{repair[\"base_commit_sha\"]}"'^{{tree}}'"'], text=True).strip() == repair[\"base_tree_oid\"]
predecessor_audit = subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"show\", f'{repair[\"predecessor_candidate_sha\"]}:.codex-fabric/audit.json'])
assert hashlib.sha256(predecessor_audit).hexdigest() == audit[\"supersedes_audit_sha256\"]
assert subprocess.run([\"git\", \"merge-base\", \"--is-ancestor\", repair[\"base_commit_sha\"], \"HEAD\"]).returncode == 0
assert subprocess.run([\"git\", \"merge-base\", \"--is-ancestor\", repair[\"predecessor_candidate_sha\"], \"HEAD\"]).returncode == 0
assert not subprocess.check_output([\"git\", \"status\", \"--porcelain\"])
print(json.dumps({

}, sort_keys=True))
